info.title: Tovuk API
info.summary: API for Tovuk public-data scraper requests.
info.description: Use the Tovuk API to list Scrapers, create paid public-data scraper Requests, fetch stored Results, authenticate, manage account billing, and open support workflows.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Account profile, usage, billing, and support endpoints.

tags.name: Scrapers
tags.description: Public-data Scraper catalog, paid Requests, stored Results, and Records.

get.description: Returns a compact API health response.
Returns the health response used by operational probes.
Returns structured dependency status and an agent instruction.

post.description: Starts a CLI device login flow.

get.description: Polls a CLI device login until complete, pending, or expired.

parameters.name: device_code
parameters.description: Opaque device code returned by login start.

put.description: Updates the authenticated account handle and display name.

get.description: Lists recent scraper, billing, and support activity for the authenticated account.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

get.description: Lists available public-data Scrapers and their price events.
Returns runtime readiness for managed public-data Scrapers.
Returns metadata, pricing, examples, and public input guidance for one Scraper.
Lists recent paid scraper Requests for the authenticated account.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Context $.paths./v1/requests.get.parameters.0.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Context $.paths./v1/requests.get.parameters.1.

post.description: Creates paid public-data scraper work. Inputs must not include cookies, passwords, private session data, private account content, private repository credentials, or proxy URLs.

get.description: Returns current status for a scraper Request.

post.description: Cancels a queued or running scraper Request.

get.description: Returns stored JSON Records for a completed scraper Request.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Context $.paths./v1/requests/{request_id}/results.get.parameters.1.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Context $.paths./v1/requests/{request_id}/results.get.parameters.2.

get.description: Returns balance, current scraper usage, and current-month cost estimates.

post.description: Creates a hosted checkout session for plan activation or balance top-up.
Creates a hosted billing portal session.

get.description: Lists recent account-scoped support tickets for the authenticated account or account API key.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Context $.paths./v1/support/tickets.get.parameters.0.

post.description: Creates a rate-limited account-scoped support ticket with scraper request evidence. Account API keys are accepted so automated agents can open service tickets.
Marks an account-scoped support ticket resolved for the authenticated account or account API key.
